facts.fact: Namibia's ICT ministry partnered with Angola, through Telecom Namibia and GGPEN, to use the Angosat-2 satellite for remote-area connectivity; discussions began in June 2025 and a proof of concept was launched (published 2025-10-14, which is the date used).

systems.platform: high-throughput geostationary satellite, C, Ku and Ka band
systems.tiers: Telecom Namibia, for remote areas and backhaul
